name: persian-pdf-studyguide-forge
author: orionshaowswmw
description: Fidelity-first pipeline that converts authorized Persian/RTL PDFs into accessible offline HTML study guides. Model-agnostic: runs on any LLM family through eight API dialects, or fully offline.

entrypoint.stdin: optional JSON job object when invoked with --stdin
entrypoint.notes: stdout is machine-readable and safe to pipe; never parse stderr

exit_codes.1: contract or QA failure (work ran, result not acceptable)
exit_codes.3: missing system dependency (poppler / tesseract / python module)

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Emit this manifest. No side effects.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose binaries, python modules, tesseract languages and available model providers.

commands.name: selftest
commands.description: Offline test suite. No keys, no network.

commands.name: compat
commands.description: Probe every reachable model and emit a compatibility matrix.

commands.name: reproduce
commands.description: Run one identical JSON contract on N models and report cross-model agreement.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Authorized PDF -> dual-OCR evidence + rendered pages.

commands.name: correct
commands.description: Evidence -> reconstructed Persian pages (primary + reviewer models).

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: Reconstructed pages -> session boundary candidates (needs review).

commands.name: enrich
commands.description: Pages + reviewed sessions -> tables, flashcards, mnemonics, review, quiz, scenarios.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Independent second-model verification of every flashcard answer.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build the self-contained offline RTL HTML study guide.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Per-page fidelity metrics and manual-review queue.

commands.name: qa
commands.description: Run measured QA gates over the built HTML.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Whole pipeline; pauses for human session-boundary review unless --auto-sessions.

providers.description: Optional providers.json; omit to auto-discover from environment

auto_sessions.description: Accept detected session boundaries without human review (marks the guide unreviewed)

outputs.studyguide.html: self-contained offline RTL study guide (Base64 images, search, quizzes, dark mode, print)
outputs.extraction/evidence.json: untouched raw dual-OCR evidence — never contains AI additions
outputs.enrichment/all.json: study aids, each carrying a source page reference

model_compatibility.offline_mode: FORGE_MOCK=1 runs the entire pipeline deterministically with no keys and no network
model_compatibility.minimum: one API key from any supported provider, or a local runtime, or FORGE_MOCK=1
model_compatibility.determinism: temperature 0, top_p 1, fixed seed where supported, canonical JSON, stable ordering, content-hash response cache
model_compatibility.reproducibility: `reproduce` measures cross-model contract agreement; `enrich --consensus N` keeps only what N model families agree on
model_compatibility.ocr: recall-first Tesseract fas+eng PSM ensemble (3/6/4) at two scales, Sauvola binarization, deskew, denoise, adaptive DPI retry, RTL-aware line reconstruction, per-page recall_report.json and low_conf_words — unchanged from 1.4.0

optional.OLLAMA_HOST: local Ollama endpoint, no key needed
optional.LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL: vLLM / LM Studio / llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible server
optional.OPENAI_BASE_URL: override the OpenAI base (proxies, LiteLLM, Azure gateways)
optional.<PROVIDER>_MODEL: pin a specific model, e.g. ANTHROPIC_MODEL, GROQ_MODEL

environment.never: The skill never reads, writes, prints or transmits a key value. Keys are read from the environment at call time and redacted from all error output.

requirements.network: optional — required only for model-assisted correction, enrichment and verification

guarantees.idempotent: every stage caches; re-running a completed stage is a no-op
guarantees.resumable: interrupted runs continue from the last cached batch
guarantees.deterministic_artifacts: all JSON artifacts are canonical (sorted keys, stable ordering)
guarantees.evidence_separation: raw evidence, reconstruction and AI study aids are three distinct files and are never merged
guarantees.no_fabrication: unverifiable flashcard answers are dropped, not invented
guarantees.stdout_purity: stdout carries only the JSON result

compat_policy.semver: MAJOR breaks the CLI contract; MINOR adds commands/flags; PATCH is behaviour-compatible
